claim: Pi 1.7.0 reports an OSC 7577 resume command to compatible terminals. It includes the session ID, non-default agent and session directories, and the original restriction and resource flags. The terminal must trust the command. The command printed at exit omits those repeated flags.
quote: The terminal resumes a command only if a rule trusts it.

claim: Pi 1.7.0 says that a thinking-level change preserves the prompt cache for supported Claude 5.x and GPT-6 models on GitHub Copilot. A tool change also preserves it for supported Claude 5.x models. Cache warming is available on Copilot Claude models.
quote: Copilot Claude models now support cache warming

claim: Copilot CLI 1.0.117 keeps MCP tool approvals for a session or location from also approving built-in requests when the server name matches a built-in permission type. The approval still covers that server after session resume. Subagents follow custom agent tool lists even if the custom agent file has no prompt.
quote: Subagents respect the tool list in their custom agent file, even when the file has no prompt.

claim: The Ollama 0.40.16 release notes say /v1/responses honors the truncation field and stops silent truncation by default.
quote: respects `truncation` and no longer silently truncates by default

claim: Vercel MCP can create, update or restore AI Gateway virtual models, add or update team-wide routing rules, and set spending budgets at team, project and member levels. Vercel requires team-level access and the relevant AI Gateway permissions. Clients can keep a virtual model ID when its model or settings change.
quote: with team-level access and the required AI Gateway permissions

claim: ShellBench reports 53,100 runs for 100 everyday tasks with twelve models and five harnesses. In an analysis of the 55 mean single-attempt pass rates for eleven models run on all five harnesses at three effort levels, model differences account for 95.7% of the sum of squares and harness differences for 0.36%. Among the top five models the shares are 65.6% and 16.5%. Several authors are OpenClaw maintainers. For 90 tasks the judge is GPT-6.1 Sol at high effort in Pi, both also evaluated in the study. In a blinded human check of individual criteria, the judge matched 250 of 278 reference labels, including 186 of its 198 passes and 64 of its 80 fails. The study reports no independent human verdicts for whole submissions.
quote: a model × harness residual, which we report as the interaction and which also absorbs sampling noise
source: ShellBench: What Matters More for AI Agents, Models, or Harness for Everyday Tasks

claim: Pi 1.7.0 defaults the global cacheWarming setting to idle. For an eligible model, Pi can send refresh requests during active runs and for up to 30 minutes between runs. The model must declare a cache lifetime and Pi must estimate at least $0.05 in avoided cache miss cost. Refresh usage counts toward session totals.
quote: for up to 30 minutes between runs

claim: The Ollama 0.40.17 release notes say that disabling thinking now selects the model's lowest supported reasoning level.
quote: Disabling thinking now maps to the model's lowest supported reasoning level
